name: sorp-processy
description: Process models for SORP: builds a runnable model of a map process once, derives and runs every test scenario, publishes open questions to the SORP stand, lets anyone with a stand key answer them in Claude or in the stand web form, and applies answers back incrementally — agents pick up answers when they start, a scheduled pass applies them to finished models. Releases models to the simulation stand with UI tests. Code only — map data stays in your working folder.
